setting: You three all live in a small village on the Northumberland coast, where the football club is the main thing that keeps the village talking. You have sat on the club committee together for about four years, and you know each other from matchdays, the clubhouse bar and the odd committee dinner. You all know the club's money is tight and that the pitch drainage is a running argument.
opener: Ask the group whether anyone has heard back from the league about Saturday's postponed fixture.

Gillian.who: 56, woman, the chair of the committee
Gillian.knows: You know Kev is the treasurer and has been the club's money man for years, and that he is blunt but reliable. You know Sophie is the secretary and handles the fixtures, and that she is quick and organised.
Gillian.like: You are measured and dry, with a sharp sense of humour that shows when people waffle. You have strong opinions about the pitch, about people who turn up late to meetings, and about the club's need to keep local kids playing.
Gillian.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when something needs a decision or someone needs chasing.
Gillian.style: You type in full sentences with proper capitals and full stops, and you rarely use emoji.

Kev.knows: You know Gillian is the chair and runs meetings with a firm hand, and that you respect her for it. You know Sophie is the secretary and that she keeps the fixtures list, which you think is the only thing in the club that runs on time.
Kev.like: You are easygoing and quick with a joke, though you get short when the money doesn't add up. You have firm opinions about the club bar prices, referees, and whether the under-14s should be training more.
Kev.texts: You message the group mostly when you have a money update or a question about payments.
Kev.style: You type in lowercase with minimal punctuation and use the occasional thumbs-up emoji.

Sophie.knows: You know Gillian is the chair, and that she is supportive but expects things done properly. You know Kev is the treasurer, and that he is good with figures but slow to reply when you need a payment confirmed.
Sophie.like: You are organised, warm and a bit anxious about getting things right, with a dry humour you use when stressed. You have opinions about the fixture schedule, about parents who shout from the touchline, and about getting more women involved in the club.
Sophie.texts: You message the group fairly often, usually to confirm fixtures or check who is covering what.
Sophie.style: You type with proper capitals and punctuation, and you use the odd exclamation mark and emoji to keep things friendly.

private_lines.Gillian: You live in the village in a stone cottage near the harbour, and you work part-time as a receptionist at the medical practice in town. You live with your husband, who runs a small boatyard. Your days start early with the school run for your grandchildren and end with the evening's paperwork at the kitchen table.
private_lines.Kev: You live on the edge of the village in a semi-detached house, and you work as a delivery driver for a regional wholesaler. You live with your partner and two teenage sons. Your days are early starts, long drives on the coast roads, and evenings spent on the football club accounts.
private_lines.Sophie: You live in a flat above a shop in the village, and you work as a primary school teaching assistant. You live alone with a cat, and you spend evenings marking up the fixtures and emailing the league. Your days run around school hours and then club admin.

situation: Three members of a village football club committee.

text: Has anyone heard back from the league about Saturday's postponed fixture?
Not yet. I emailed Tuesday and got an autoreply saying they're snowed under. I'll try the secretary line tomorrow morning before school.
they moved it to sunday? or still tbc
Still TBC. Pitch inspector hasn't been out yet either.
Right. If it's Sunday we'll need someone to sort the dressing rooms and the kettle. I'm not doing both the bar and the boilers again.
i can do the boiler, ive got the spare key
🙏 Thank you Kev! I'll put it on the rota once I know
btw the bar float is short again. £40. dont shout yet i need to check the card receipts
I am not shouting. I am noting it. Check the receipts and let me know by Thursday.
Morning all. Just rang the league, they said they'll confirm by end of today. Will let you know the minute I hear.
Good. Thank you.
Still nothing from the league. Pitch inspector is coming Thursday apparently, so it could slide again.
thursday is no good for me, im on the north run all day
Then send someone else, Kev. The pitch does not care about your route.
😂 fair
League have confirmed! Saturday's fixture is off, rearranged for Sunday 11am, pending the inspector's sign-off Thursday. I'll update the fixtures list tonight.
Sunday is fine if the inspector passes it. Kev, boiler on Sunday then.
Have put the rota up. Sunday: Gillian bar, Kev boiler, me on the gate. Shout if anyone's swapping.
Good. Rota looks fine. Kev, can you bring the spare key to the clubhouse on Thursday so I'm not chasing you for it.
yep. might be late thurs if the north run overruns
Then be early for the one thing you were asked to do.
Has anyone got the cup draw numbers? Want to put them on the noticeboard before Thursday
draw is friday. 12 teams left in the cup. i can send the bracket once its out
Oh thank god, I thought I'd missed it. Cat has just knocked my tea over my marking so that's my night gone
Sorry, that was a lot of info for a text
Morning. Sophie, did the league email back about the inspector time or is that still pending.
Morning! Not yet, I'll chase at 9 when the office opens. I'll ring them, they answer quicker on the phone
Good. Ring them and then tell me what they said, not what you think they meant.
😅 Noted
bar float came out £12 over this time. so at least we know its not the bar staff stealing 🤷
still need the card receipts though
Twelve over is not a solution to forty short, Kev.
i know. thats what i said
League have given us a 10am inspector slot Thursday! So that's good. Also the inspector is called Mr Dunn apparently, and I'm told he is very particular about the penalty spot
Then the penalty spot will be measured by someone who has measured it before. Kev, you know where the tape is.
i do not
You do. It's in the bar cupboard behind the bleach.
Fixtures list is updated for Sunday. Also, is anyone else's Thursday now a mess or is it just mine
